fr.elements: Main Residence; Access Drive; Landscaped Area; Open Terrain; Detached Structure; Walkway
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Open Terrain; Vegetation Near Structure
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with posts or reflectors on both sides to define the entry point and prevent responders from missing the turn.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris so fire apparatus and ambulances can reach the main residence without obstruction.
• Maintain driveway width and overhead clearance along the entire length to allow large emergency vehicles to pass without stopping.
• Identify a turnaround area near the main residence or detached structure where apparatus can reverse direction without backing the full length of the driveway.
• Mark or post the turnaround location so arriving responders can locate it immediately.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway that narrows the travel path or reduces visibility for drivers approaching the structures.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around the exterior of both buildings without obstruction.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear so responders can move quickly between the two buildings.
• Post the property address on or near both structures if they are not visible from the driveway approach.
• Keep any gates along the driveway unlocked or equipped with a Knox Box so responders are not delayed

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Trees; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Terrain; Scattered Shrubs; Long Driveway; Single Access Route; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Grass Cover
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang over or touch the roof and walls of the structure.
• Thin scattered trees close to the structure to create more open space between the canopy and the building.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the foundation or exterior walls.
• Thin shrub clusters within close range of the structure to break up continuous vegetation surrounding the building.
• Mow or cut the grass cover around the structure short, particularly during dry periods.
• Keep the full length of the driveway clear of overhanging branches to allow emergency vehicles to pass through without obstruction.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate quickly from the road.
• Keep the driveway surface and shoulders clear of dead grass and loose plant debris that could carry fire along its length.
• Maintain the open terrain areas around the structure by preventing shrub and grass growth from filling in and reducing the separation that currently exists.
